summary: Excellent production-ready code. Workflow has pinned action versions, least-privilege permissions (contents: read), concurrency control, and sensible triggers. TypeScript throughout uses explicit types, proper async/await, and meaningful error propagation. No dead code or duplication. Modular design (types→parser→aggregator→markdown→cli) with graceful degradation (skips malformed files). Clear naming and comments explain WHY. Edge cases handled well (XML entities, flexible JSON schemas, missing fields). GitHub Actions integration via GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY and machine-readable output. Exit codes correct (0 even on test failures—expected). Minor: XML entity decoder omits numeric entities, but appropriate for JUnit XML.
